experiment.fault: Cloud and controller absent while the identical local backlogs are captured; all recovery services start at t=0

measurement_boundaries.middleware: Cloud ASGI middleware duration for authenticated replay POST and reconciliation GET traffic in each process-local rolling window
measurement_boundaries.client: host-observed end-to-end duration of one authenticated replay status GET per applied event, measured after middleware snapshots
measurement_boundaries.queueing: Hospital durable pending-event trajectory plus AnyIO executor wait depth sampled by each Cloud /metrics endpoint
measurement_boundaries.not_measured: socket accept queues, upstream/network queues, PostgreSQL lock/connection queues
